description: This file contains test functions for the 'TaskRunner' component, specifically testing asynchronous execution of error-returning functions.

methods.name: funcWithErr
methods.description: Returns an error with a fixed message, used to simulate an error condition in tests.

methods.name: funcNoErr
methods.description: Returns nil error, used to simulate successful function execution in tests.

methods.name: TestExecuteFunctionsAsyncErrExists
methods.description: Test that verifies ExecuteFunctionsAsync correctly reports an error when one of the functions returns an error.

methods.name: TestExecuteFunctionsAsyncNoErr
methods.description: Test that verifies ExecuteFunctionsAsync reports no error when all functions succeed.
